I'm on a spot-price electricity contract. Please schedule these appliance cycles for 2024-07-15 so that my electricity cost is as low as possible, without exceeding my household peak load limit:
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 08:45, must finish by 17:15
- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 12:00, must finish by 24:00

results.label: Multi-Agent Pipeline
results.message: Your appliances are scheduled to run at the same time for optimal efficiency! The dishwasher will start at 14:00 and finish by 14:30, while the washing machine will also begin at 14:00 and complete its cycle by 15:00. The estimated cost for this schedule is quite low, and it comfortably stays within your household peak load limit. Enjoy your clean dishes and laundry!
